claims.assertion: Yazhi says people are perspectives of one being; integrating others’ viewpoints through self-love dissolves separation, fear, and conflict.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi describes her body as an idea she can mentally alter or remove, while choosing to project a physical form.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She describes these changes as occurring in her mind.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says death does not automatically grant higher consciousness: people retain their ideas and Matrix in the astral and plan lives from that limited perspective.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says consciousness depends on understanding, not embodiment.
